crossRefs.note: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter…
As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’ ”

translations.web: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”
translations.bsb: And again, as He says in the passage above: “They shall never enter My rest.”
translations.kjv: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
translations.asv: and in this place again, They shall not enter into my rest.
